sources.evidence: Implementer and root independently fetched readable body; root read the final appendix through offset27000 and9000-character window
facts: Use financial Chinese digits and place units with 人民币 immediately before the amount.
An amount ending at 元 has 整/正; after 角 整/正 is optional; an amount with 分 does not append 整/正.
Internal zeros can be compressed; zero 角 and nonzero 分 require 零 after 元.
The text explicitly permits alternative zero forms for examples1680.32 and107000.53.
sources.implementation_choices: One allowed deterministic spelling; nonnegative decimal text only, at most12 significant integer digits and2 decimals, no implicit rounding. The128-code-unit input and numeric ceiling are application limits, not legal limits.
sources.limit: Not a claim that the entire historical settlement law is unamended/current or that generated wording guarantees bank/voucher acceptance.
